profile.headline: Software Engineer | AI & Machine Learning | Building AI Agents | Technical TA at Handshake
profile.jobTitle: Technical Teaching Assistant | Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Data Analytics with Databricks
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer and AI educator who builds data and AI systems that solve real problems for real people.

As a full stack engineer at Innowatts, I built features for a SaaS platform using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Postgres. My work included usage-limit monitoring across the frontend and backend, API validation that protected database integrity, and real-time notifications. I also work in Python, SQL, and C, and I’ve built ML models through a Google-sponsored residency with ColorWave.

Today I’m a Technical Teaching Assistant at Handshake (formerly Uplimit), supporting courses in Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Data Analytics with Databricks. I recently built Duplex Investor, an AI agent in Claude for real estate investment analysis and investor outreach, and presented it at the AI Agent Foundations Demo Day with ColorWave and MLT.

Before tech, I led data programs at the City of Los Angeles, including the city’s first Open Data Literacy Program, and that work still shapes how I build: start with the people it’s meant to serve.

Let’s connect, or see my work on GitHub: github.com/Kimberly-Rodriguez

positions.title: Technical Teaching Assistant | Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Data Analytics with Databricks
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
As a technical TA for cutting-edge courses in AI and Data, I provide technical, instructional, and analytical support to students and instructors alike. My role bridges real-time student needs with course goals, ensuring a dynamic and productive learning environment.

Responsibilities:

Provide real-time technical support to students during live sessions and labs, helping troubleshoot code errors and clarify complex ML/AI concepts.

Triage and escalate questions to instructors as needed to maintain seamless instructional flow.

Collaborate with instructors to reinforce learning objectives and identify areas where students need additional guidance.

Monitor and analyze student interactions with the AI-powered algorithm support bot, surfacing key insights on usage trends and effectiveness.

Collaborate with the ML course team to refine support systems and improve bot accuracy.

Answer technical and conceptual questions on labs involving:

Prompt engineering for GenAI use cases

Model evaluation and selection

Data warehousing workflows using Databricks

Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), feature engineering, and model tuning

Contributions:
Helped optimize the algorithm support bot based on student interaction patterns, improving resolution rates and enhancing learning efficiency.

Supported multiple learners across multiple cohorts, increasing overall course satisfaction and reducing lab completion times through timely technical assistance.

Delivered actionable feedback to curriculum developers on student pain points, improving future course iterations.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · SQL · Modeling · Data Analysis · Algorithms

positions.title: AI Agent Foundations Fellow | Colorwave & MLT
positions.description:
A competitive five-week cohort on agentic AI design, covering agent frameworks, tool use, and the deployment of workflows that take real actions. The capstone project, Duplex Investor, is an LLM-based agent built in Claude that automates real estate investment analysis and investor outreach.

System design: Wrote the agent’s system instructions, defining its role, objective, and output standards so it behaves consistently across runs.

Context grounding: Set up a retrieval order where the agent pulls from private property files and buyer-profile data before using web search, which reduced unsupported claims.

Tool orchestration: Connected file access, web research, financial calculations, email drafting, and a prospect tracker so one natural-language request triggers a multi-step pipeline.

Reliability guardrails: Built in epistemic labeling (every claim tagged fact, assumption, or unknown), a no-guessing rule for figures, and automatic flags for regulatory risk.

Segmentation and personalization: The agent classifies investors into buyer personas (1031 exchange, owner-occupant), matches them to the asset, and generates persona-specific emails under 150 words with a clear call to action.

Generated deliverables: The agent produces a one-page marketing flyer for each persona from the same underlying data.

Iterative refinement: Tested the agent, found where it went wrong, and tightened its instructions and constraints over several rounds.

Live deployment: Ran the full workflow live at Demo Day and walked through the agent’s design decisions.

positions.title: Software Engineer | Data
positions.description:
One of six full stack engineers focused on the company’s SaaS platform built on React frontend, multiple microservice Node.js backends, Postgres databases, Okta authorization, and authentication processes, among other systems.

Design and implement a system to monitor user metric capacity, integrating checks in both frontend and backend. Deliver functionality that prevents users from exceeding limits, enhancing user control with prompt options when limits are reached.

Resolve a critical bug in microservice REST validations that compromise database integrity by accepting excessively long strings. Optimize the validation process by enforcing string length checks at the request entry point using the AJV library, ensuring data integrity.

Play a key role in developing a new notification component from scratch, enhancing the user experience with real-time, actionable alerts.

Led a two-week technical sprint focused on building new data-filtering features, culminating in a company-wide demo showcasing the functionality, resulting in positive feedback and broader adoption of the features across teams.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Node.js · Express.js · JavaScript · HTML5 · CSS Flexbox · MongoDB · SQL · PostgreSQL · okta · JSON Web Token (JWT)

positions.title: Assistant Instructor | Full Stack Web Development
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Assist in delivering a full-stack web development curriculum (HTML, CSS, ES6+, SQL, MongoDB, RESTful APIs, PWAs, React, GraphQL), providing students with hands-on support to strengthen their coding and application development skills.

Support the creation and implementation of lesson plans, facilitating active discussions and project-based learning to help students grasp complex programming concepts and improve retention.

Provide timely and constructive feedback on student projects, helping students refine their coding techniques and resolve challenges, which contributes to higher-quality project outcomes and student confidence.

Aid students during activity and project work by offering real-time assistance and reviewing code, ensuring students stay on track and meet project deadlines with clear, concise solutions.

Foster an empathy-centered learning environment, encouraging students through challenging material and offering personalized support to build their resilience and confidence in coding.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · TypeScript · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Git · GitHub · Gitlab · Node.js · Express.js · Apollo GraphQL · MySQL · Sequelize.js · MongoDB · RestfulAPI · Visual Studio · sql management

positions.title: Technical Resident in Machine Learning
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Google-sponsored technical residency focused on developing AI/ML expertise through practical, hands-on experience.

@Sortile (Start-up Collaboration) 

Delivered a 2% performance improvement over baseline by driving end-to-end machine learning model development, optimizing classification models, and implementing noise reduction techniques to enhance sensor data quality.

Enhanced data reliability and model accuracy by conducting in-depth research on noise effects and rigorously testing advanced denoising techniques.

Spearheaded fellowship group initiatives, resolving complex technical challenges, coordinating expert consultations, and streamlining progress reporting to ensure team success and alignment.

Earned recognition for leadership, determination, and collaboration, contributing to measurable impacts for the fellowship team and partner organization.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Machine Learning · Python (Programming Language) · pyplot

positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Data Programs Lead, City of Los Angeles, Department of Neighborhood Empowerment
positions.description:
Launched the inaugural Open Data Literacy Program and developed a user-focused, map-based portal, boosting open data portal usage by 40% and training over 400 residents on data tools, fostering greater community engagement.
 
Reconfigured the public-facing constituent request portal, simplifying the submission process and reducing steps by 30%, while creating self-help content that improved internal staff productivity by 20% and enhanced the overall user experience.
 
Utilized city-data tools such as Esri ArcGIS Online, Tableau, and Socrata to generate actionable insights, directly informing policy decisions and driving data-driven strategies.

positions.title: Project Manager, Census and Budget Initiatives, Mayor's Office of Budget and Innovation
positions.description:
Developed an interactive community asset map featuring 250 strategic contacts to support coalition-building efforts, utilizing a minimalist design to enhance usability and engagement.
 
Led a team of four research fellows and served as interim team lead, overseeing the completion of foundational research, including peer city analysis, which directly informed the administration's action plan.
 
Supported the Deputy Mayor of Budget and Innovation on special projects related to the annual city budget report, contributing to the timely and efficient delivery of key fiscal information.

positions.title: Analyst, Innovation Team, Mayor's Office of Budget & Innovation w/ Bloomberg Philanthropies
positions.description:
Collaborated with a user experience designer and team lead to launch an awareness campaign for the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, increasing community engagement by 15% and enhancing public understanding of key housing policies, while leading focus groups and ideation sessions to develop targeted, in-language campaigns around affordable housing in partnership with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD).
 
Conducted and analyzed 50+ in-person interviews and researched best practices across 30 cities, using these insights to develop actionable work plans for civic engagement and neighborhood revitalization without displacement, directly influencing local policy strategies and supporting the agendas of the Mayor's Office and Housing Department.
 
Designed and implemented a leadership curriculum for the Civic Youth Program, empowering youth candidates to leverage open data resources, resulting in an 8% increase in voter engagement among young adults and stronger decision-making in their campaigns for Neighborhood Council, in partnership with the Department of Neighborhood Empowerment.

positions.title: Central and South LA Area Representative, Mayor's Office of External Affairs
positions.description:
Managed stakeholder relationships by formulating weekly newsletters, oral reports, workshops/meetings, and issue-based memos, fostering strong communication and ensuring alignment with community needs in Central and South LA.
 
Briefed and supported Mayor Eric Garcetti and senior staff during their first international trade trip to Mexico City, in collaboration with the Mayor's International Trade team, providing critical research, reports, and briefings that informed key decisions and facilitated successful diplomatic and economic engagement between the two cities.
 
Supported the Executive Officer during weekend responsibilities, staffing the Mayor at various public and private events to ensure seamless coordination and representation.

positions.description: Developed a booklet using popular education methods to empower community leaders in driving sustainability initiatives that improve education, expand green spaces, and influence local policy.

positions.description: Guided community college students through the transfer process to four-year institutions, ensuring transferable credits, GPA requirements, and course alignment, resulting in increased transfer success.
